ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Approval Process"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Expired')) , OR( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Comments__c) ), $User.Id <> Needs_to_be_Approved_by__c )
